# Pubudu Electronics (ichouse.lk)

> Leading online and physical electronic components store in Sri Lanka, supplying original ICs, transistors, MOSFETs, Arduino/ESP32 modules, relays, power adapters, sensors, and DIY electronics with island-wide delivery.

## Overview
- **Brand / Store Name:** Pubudu Electronics
- **Official Website:** https://ichouse.lk/
- **Physical Address:** Weliweriya, Gampaha District, Western Province, Sri Lanka
- **Contact Hotline / WhatsApp:** +94 78 915 5130
- **Business Hours:** Monday – Sunday: 08:00 – 20:00 (Sri Lanka Time / IST)
- **Target Audience:** Electronics engineers, robotics hobbyists, students, repair technicians, and makers in Sri Lanka and worldwide.

## Delivery & Payment in Sri Lanka
- **Island-wide Delivery:** Available across all 25 districts of Sri Lanka (Colombo, Gampaha, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Kurunegala, Matara, etc.) via prompt courier service.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 1 to 3 business days across Sri Lanka.
- **Payment Options:**
  - Cash on Delivery (COD)
  - Bank Transfer / Online Banking
  - LANKAQR
- **Pickup Option:** Local pickup available at Weliweriya, Gampaha.
- **Returns & Warranty:** 7-day merchant return window for eligible components. Pre-tested components before dispatch.

## Product Categories & Direct Links
- [Semiconductors & ICs](https://ichouse.lk/ic/): Voltage regulators, audio ICs, timer ICs, logic gates, operational amplifiers, melody ICs.
- [Transistors](https://ichouse.lk/transistor/): NPN/PNP bipolar junction transistors, power transistors (e.g., 2SC, 2SD series).
- [MOSFETs](https://ichouse.lk/mosfet/): High voltage and logic-level N-channel and P-channel power MOSFETs.
- [IGBTs](https://ichouse.lk/igbt/): High-power insulated-gate bipolar transistors for induction cookers, inverters, and welders.
- [Arduino & IoT Modules](https://ichouse.lk/module/): Relay boards, step-down (buck) converters, step-up (boost) converters, battery chargers (TP4056, TP5100), thermostat modules.
- [BMS & Battery Protection](https://ichouse.lk/bms/): 1S to 6S Li-ion and LiFePO4 battery management and balance protection boards.
- [Relays](https://ichouse.lk/relays/): 5V, 12V, 24V automotive and PCB power relays (10A to 40A).
- [Capacitors](https://ichouse.lk/capacitor/): Electrolytic, polyester film, and ceramic disc capacitors.
- [Resistors](https://ichouse.lk/resistors/): Metal film, carbon film, and high-wattage ceramic cement wirewound resistors.
- [Power Adapters & SMPS](https://ichouse.lk/power-adapter/): 5V, 9V, 12V, 24V switching power supplies and metal cage industrial power adapters.
- [Solar & Energy Products](https://ichouse.lk/solar/): PWM solar charge controllers, mini solar panels, emergency solar lights.
- [Cooling Fans](https://ichouse.lk/fan/): 12V / 24V DC brushless cooling fans for enclosures and electronics.
- [Meters & Panel Displays](https://ichouse.lk/panel-meter/): Digital voltmeters, ammeters, and single-phase digital watt-hour meters.
- [Transformers](https://ichouse.lk/transformer/): Step-down AC power transformers (230V to 6V, 9V, 12V, 24V dual/single output).
- [Diodes & Bridge Rectifiers](https://ichouse.lk/rectifier/): Fast-recovery diodes, Schottky, Zener, and heavy-duty bridge rectifier modules.
- [Cables & Connectors](https://ichouse.lk/connecter/): Audio jacks, DC sockets, terminal blocks, coaxial splitters, USB Type-C sockets.
